svg.text: MoveIn Proof: architecture and data flow
MVVM + use cases + repositories. SwiftUI, SwiftData, AVFoundation, WidgetKit. All storage is on the device.
CaptureView sends the tap to CaptureViewModel.
The ViewModel captures the image with CameraController,
stamps the date and time on it and calls CapturePhoto.
CapturePhoto saves the JPEG through PhotoFileStorage and
adds the Photo (and an Issue if tagged) through
saveChanges() commits to SwiftData. If that fails the
JPEG is deleted and MoveInError.storageFailed is thrown.
SwiftData observation updates the screen. Errors are
shown as an alert by the ViewModel.
WidgetSync also writes a snapshot for the widget.
Deleting a room cascades to its photos and issues.
Deleting an issue keeps its photos.
Each layer only calls the one below it.
Views never import SwiftData; use cases only
UI state runs on the main actor; the camera
session has its own serial queue.
No network access. The widget reads a copy of
the key dates from the App Group.
